boxes.name: E2B sandbox
boxes.description: Temporary isolated E2B Linux VM. One box per chat until it is killed or times out. Home is /home/user. Use for short-lived code, charts, and throwaway commands.

boxes.name: InstaBox Linux computer
boxes.description: Persistent InstaBox Linux computer (Debian, /data disk, optional desktop). Shared and reused across turns for every user and group. Home is /data/home. Use for projects, servers, files that should last, and the desktop.
